app.name: PocketChest
app.description: Private, self-hosted sharing for files and text. One Worker, one R2 bucket, no database.

inputs.description: Optional. At least 8 characters, with both letters and digits. Leave empty and the app generates one on first setup: read it from the private R2 object auth/initial-owner-password.txt, then change it in Security settings. Only used for the first setup: an upgrade does not ask for it and keeps your current password.
inputs.label: Owner password
